long_biography.plain_text:
After training for a maritime career, Suescun entered the beauty trade as a commercial director for a German hair-centre operator. At twenty-seven he joined friends to acquire a failed Valencia business for a modest sum. A later merger created Corporación Dermoestética, where mass-market pricing, consumer finance and heavy advertising helped normalise elective cosmetic procedures for a broad Spanish clientele.

Suescun led the chain beyond Spain and floated it in Madrid while retaining control. He also sold its British laser-eye subsidiary and channelled part of his fortune into a family office, real estate and maritime ventures. The clinic group eventually closed after financial distress and entered liquidation, but registry filings continued to place him in governance roles at Soul Corporación and Naviera Pizarro.
